blocked.name: Natural habitat of Pyrus calleryana in Tado (多度のマメバモモウ自生地 / Tado no Mamebonashi Jiseichi)
blocked.species: Pyrus calleryana var. dimorphophylla (Mamenashi / dwarf Callery pear)
blocked.why: Not a single tree. Designated a Japanese Natural Monument (2010-08-05) protecting a WILD POPULATION on Mt. Tado: sources describe over 40 mature specimens of this endangered, Ise-Bay-endemic pear growing naturally across the hillside. Commons category and lead coordinates (35.13361,136.60976) point at a habitat/plant community, not one identifiable trunk. Under BRIEF_RESEARCH.md's collectible-point rule this is an ensemble/wood, not an entry. If a single standout specimen within the population is ever separately named and located by a source, it could be reconsidered on its own merits, but no source found in this pass singles one out.
